system.summary: Not one system: at least six — a letter substitution with nomenclator (R9325), a monoalphabetic graphic cipher with word signs (Łaski, R9322/23/17), homophonic graphic ciphers in German (R9416, R9368 family), a Latin-letter cipher (R9424), and a dot grille (R9319).
system.sibling_key: R9324 (key for R9325) in the same volume; R9423 key register of 19 1530s keys; R9422 1582-83 key probably for R9424

prior_solution.where: Contemporary interlinear decipherments on R9322, R9323, R9416, R9417, R9424 (names), R9427 and R9368 (a sibling); no edition of this volume found (web search 2026-09-21).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie supplied; problem posed with /goal; the user asked for a period German model. No target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Web search for KAA 4591 and Augurelio ciphers
DECODE record list from the API dump (141 records in the volume); images of the 14 targets and 30 neighbouring keys fetched with the cookie
R9325 matched to key R9324 by identical null signs; applied
Łaski cipher key rebuilt from 153 glossed word pairs on R9322/R9417; unglossed lines decoded
R9416 f.262 gloss transcribed (read at the time)
Constrained homophonic annealing with de-modern on R9424
Built de-1500s model from 145 Deutsches Textarchiv prints 1472-1609; annealing on R9416 f.263 (3150 signs) gave running German (Pressburg talks, Gritti)
R9416 f.263 re-transcribed splitting look-alike signs found by the solver's errors
Key from the R9368 gloss applied to R9410
R9427 gloss aligned: 'ewr F.G.' anchors the R9409/R9410 system; pinned annealing on R9410 and R9409
R9423 key-register block 2_4 (Hz. Wilhelm) applied to R9367
R9422 (1582-83) Latin-letter alphabet applied to R9424
Annealing with nulls allowed on R9424, R9367, R9410
Full-zoom alignment of the R9427 gloss gave the System A' key; R9410 and R9409 read in part
R9408 (1534, ~7,300 signs) transcribed and read in part with the System A' key
Lasry (25 Sept 2026): split mixed cases. Primary method stays key from adjacent plaintext; R9416 f. 263, broken ciphertext-only, is a second part with its own Results row.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Most of what is read comes from keys rebuilt from contemporary glosses in the same key volume: System B (Łaski letters R9322, R9323, R9417) from 153 interlinear gloss pairs, System A′ (R9408-R9413) from the gloss on R9427; R9325 was read with key R9324 filed a few folios earlier, and R9416 f. 263 was broken ciphertext-only.
outcome.notes: Read: R9325, R9322, R9417; mostly R9323; R9416 f.262 at the time; R9416 f.263 broken (working decrypt). Open: R9408, R9409, R9410, R9413, R9424, R9427, R9367; R9319 blocked (cover letters not imaged); R9291 is a key fragment.
